name: Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Studies

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an original confirmation of studies or enrolment under Section 64 of Act No. 326/1999 Coll., covering university programmes, language preparation courses, or exchange programmes.
requirements.fix_path: Secure confirmed enrolment at a qualifying institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate proof of funds sufficient to support the stay.

evidence_required.document: Health insurance (comprehensive; travel insurance for first 90 days if under 18)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, extendable to 2 years in specific circumstances

sources.title: ipc.gov.cz -- Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Studies: enrolment requirement, proof of funds/accommodation, health insurance, free labour-market access, CZK2,500 fee

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. work_rights set to 'full': the source states students holding this permit 'work here without an additional permit (free access to the labour market)' -- notably more generous than most other countries' student routes in this dataset, which typically cap part-time hours. family_can_join set false: the source did not address accompanying family members for this specific permit category (family members would separately apply via cz_family_reunification).
